messages.subject: Garrety - settlement signed and concluded
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Naomi,

The settlement agreement has now been signed by both parties and by the adviser. Executed copy attached. Termination date is 9 May 2025 by reason of redundancy. Final terms: PILON £148,000, statutory redundancy £9,330, ex-gratia £95,000 (first £30k tax-free), £2,500 fees contribution and outplacement up to £5,000; 9-month restrictive covenants reaffirmed. Please arrange the payments within 28 days. The protective ET1 will not be presented. Matter effectively closed.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
